text: きれいな　まちづくりが　じまんの　タマムシに　ゲーム　コーナーが　できちゃって！

structure.jp: きれいな　まちづくりが　じまんの　タマムシに
structure.en: in Celadon, which prides itself on its beautiful townscape

structure.jp: ゲーム　コーナーが　できちゃって！
structure.en: a Game Corner has gone and been built!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the short spoken form of てしまう, which says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. できちゃって = 'it went and got built'.

patterns.name: 〜がじまんの
patterns.span: きれいな　まちづくりが　じまんの　タマムシ
patterns.explanation: X が じまんの before a noun describes it as something that is proud of X. まちづくりが じまんの タマムシ = 'Celadon, proud of its town planning'.

patterns.name: 〜て (trailing off)
patterns.explanation: Ending on the て-form leaves the sentence hanging, with the complaint continuing in the next line. できちゃって = 'it got built, and...'.
